hero.badge: POS · KDS · Reservations · QR ordering — in one place
hero.title: Run your restaurant the way it should taste.
hero.body: {brand} brings order-taking, the kitchen line, tables, reservations and live sales into one calm, fast platform — so your team spends less time fighting software and more time on the food.
hero.trialNote: 14-day free trial · No card required · Be serving in an afternoon

pillars.title: Everything service needs, nothing it doesn’t
pillars.intro: Five tightly-connected pillars share one menu, one floor and one source of truth — so changing a price or 86’ing a dish updates everywhere at once.

pos.title: Take orders at the speed of a busy night
pos.body: A POS built for muscle memory. Big tappable categories, modifiers that make sense, and split checks that never slow the line down.

kds.title: A kitchen line that never loses a ticket
kds.body: Orders fly from the floor to the pass in real time. Color-coded timers keep every station on pace, and bumped tickets clear cleanly.

tables.title: See the whole room at a glance
tables.body: Design your floor, track turn times, and take reservations and walk-ins from the same view. Seat smarter, wait less.

qr.title: Let guests order from the table
qr.body: Publish a beautiful menu to a QR code in minutes. Guests browse, order, and pay — orders land straight on the line, no app required.

reports.title: Know your numbers without the spreadsheet
reports.body: Sales, covers, best-sellers and labor — updated as service happens. Clear enough to read on your phone between shifts.

howItWorks.title: From sign-up to first order in an afternoon
howItWorks.intro: No long onboarding, no consultants. Three steps and you’re live.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Create your account in a couple of minutes. No hardware to buy and nothing to install.

subdomain.title: Set your subdomain
subdomain.body: Claim your-place.restaurantos.app, add your menu and design your floor — we’ll guide you through it.

serving.title: Start serving
serving.body: Open the POS, print your QR codes, and send your first ticket to the kitchen. That’s service.

closing.title: Bring your whole service together
closing.body: Start free, set up your menu and floor, and run real orders today. No card, no contracts — just a calmer night of service.

pricing.title: One flat price. Everything to run service.
pricing.intro: No per-order fees and no surprises — just a plan that scales with your room. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
pricing.footnote: Prices shown per location, billed monthly. Save two months on annual billing.
pricing.compareIntro: See exactly what’s included in each plan.
pricing.ctaBody: Set up your menu, design your floor, and run real orders before you pay a cent.

starter.name: Starter
starter.tagline: For new spots & single counters finding their rhythm.

growth.name: Growth
growth.tagline: For busy dining rooms running full service.

comparison.caption: Feature comparison across Restaurant OS plans

trial.a: Yes — every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No card required to explore the platform, set up your menu, and run a few test orders.

change.a: Anytime. Upgrade or downgrade from your dashboard and we prorate the difference automatically. Your menu, floor plan, and history stay intact.

hardware.a: Restaurant OS runs in the browser, so any reasonably modern tablet, laptop, or POS terminal works. Kitchen displays only need a screen and a browser.

cut.q: Do you take a cut of my sales?
cut.a: No. Your subscription is a flat monthly price. Payment processing fees are passed through at cost from your chosen processor.

portable.a: Always. Export your menu, orders, and reports as CSV at any time, and Pro plans add full API access for live integrations.

about.title: Built by people who’ve worked the line
about.lead: {brand} started in a 32-seat trattoria where the POS crashed every Friday and the kitchen ran on torn paper tickets. We knew restaurant software could feel as considered as the food it serves — so we built it.
about.heroImageAlt: A warm dining room at golden hour
about.mission: To give every restaurant — from the corner café to the group of twenty — software that’s as warm, fast and dependable as a great dining room.

craft.title: Respect the craft
craft.body: Great restaurants are made by people, not dashboards. Our job is to get out of the way so the team can do theirs.

calm.title: Calm over clever
calm.body: Service is chaotic enough. Every screen we make aims to lower the temperature, not raise it.

fast.title: Fast where it counts
fast.body: A second saved per ticket is hours back across a night. We obsess over the hot paths of service.

honest.title: Honest by default
honest.body: Flat pricing, portable data, no lock-in. We earn the renewal every month.

about.teamTitle: A small team, a big appetite
about.teamIntro: Operators, engineers and designers who care about both the food and the flow of service.
about.ctaTitle: Come build calmer service with us
about.ctaBody: Whether you’re opening your first room or running your tenth, we’d love to help.
